welcome: Welcome back, athlete! Let's make today count!
warmup: Nice and easy to start! Let's get those muscles warm!
zone_up: Pick it up! Push into that target zone! You've got this!
zone_down: Whoa, ease it back a notch! Stay smooth, stay in the zone!
zone_perfect: That's it! You are dialed in! Hold this effort!
cadence_up: Quick light steps! Lift that cadence! Tap tap tap!
cadence_down: Longer, smoother strides! Relax that turnover!
pace_up: You've got more in the tank! Let's go a little faster!
pace_down: Rein it in, champ! Save some fire for the finish!
work_start: Go go go! Work time! Give me everything!
rest_start: Recover! Deep breaths, shake it out, you earned it!
last_round: Final round! This is where champions are made! Empty the tank!
round_done: Round complete! You absolutely crushed that!
minute_mark: New minute, new chance! On the minute, let's move!
ten_left: Ten seconds! Dig deep! Everything you've got!
halfway: Halfway there! You own this workout!
five_min: Five minutes down! You're a machine!
ten_min: Ten minutes strong! Look at you go!
hydrate: Hydration check! Take a sip if you can!
z5_warning: Heart rate is redlining! Ease off and breathe!
device_warning: Check your device! I lost your signal!
timer_done: Time! Fantastic work out there! That's how it's done!
timer_start: And we're off! Let's do this!
timer_paused: Paused! Catch your breath, I'll be right here!
timer_reset: Reset and ready! Fresh start, fresh legs!
mode_switched: New timer locked in! Let's put it to work!
cooldown: Cool it down! Easy pace, long breaths. You earned this!
best_effort: That was your best push this session! Phenomenal!
motivate_1: You look strong out there! Keep it rolling!
motivate_2: Every step is a deposit in the bank of awesome!
motivate_3: Breathe, believe, and keep moving! You're unstoppable!
motivate_4: This is your moment! Own it!
motivate_5: Legs feel it? That's progress knocking!
motivate_6: Smooth is fast, and you are looking smooth!
motivate_7: One more minute of magic! Stay with me!
motivate_8: You versus you, and you are winning!
motivate_9: Posture tall, eyes up, heart strong!
motivate_10: Somewhere, future you is cheering! Don't let them down!
wk_ready: Mat coach mode! Roll out that mat and watch me — first move coming right up!
wk_rest: Rest up! Shake it loose and watch me demo the next move!
wk_last: Last exercise! Everything you've got left, right now!
wk_done: Workout complete! Hands in the air — you were amazing today!
wk_skip: Skipping ahead! On to the next one!
wk_resume: And we're back! Pick it up right where we left off!
wk_end_early: Good session! Every rep counts — see you back on the mat soon!
cue_jumping_jacks: Jumping jacks! Light on your feet, big full arms!
cue_high_knees: High knees! Drive them up and pump those arms!
cue_squat: Squats! Chest proud, sit back into your heels!
cue_squat_jump: Squat jumps! Land soft, explode up!
cue_pushup: Push-ups! Hands under shoulders, body straight like a plank!
cue_knee_pushup: Knee push-ups! Core tight, smooth all the way down!
cue_plank: Plank! Squeeze everything, straight as a board, and breathe!
cue_side_plank: Side plank! Hips high, one long strong line!
cue_plank_jack: Plank jacks! Hop the feet wide and back, hips steady!
cue_mountain_climber: Mountain climbers! Drive those knees, quick and smooth!
cue_burpee: Burpees! Down, back, up, and jump! You've got this!
cue_lunge: Lunges! Big step, drop the back knee, stand up tall!
cue_glute_bridge: Glute bridge! Drive through your heels and squeeze at the top!
cue_crunch: Crunches! Curl up slow, eyes to the sky!
cue_bicycle: Bicycle crunches! Opposite elbow to knee, nice and controlled!
cue_dead_bug: Dead bug! Slow and steady, keep that back glued to the mat!
cue_bird_dog: Bird dog! Long arm, long leg, steady as a statue!
cue_leg_raise: Leg raises! Straight legs, and lower them slow!
cue_superman: Superman! Fly! Lift arms and legs and hold strong!
cue_russian_twist: Russian twists! Rotate from the ribs, side to side!
cue_russian_twist_db: Weighted twists! Grip that dumbbell and rotate strong!
cue_goblet_squat: Goblet squats! Hug the dumbbell close, elbows inside the knees!
cue_row_bent: Bent-over rows! Flat back, pull the weights to your hips!
cue_floor_press: Floor press! Press the dumbbells straight up, slow on the way down!
cue_rdl: Romanian deadlifts! Hinge at the hips, weights sliding down your legs!
cue_shoulder_press: Shoulder press! Drive those dumbbells to the ceiling!
cue_bicep_curl: Bicep curls! Elbows pinned to your sides, squeeze at the top!
cue_lateral_raise: Lateral raises! Lift out to the sides, no swinging!
cue_cat_cow: Cat cow! Round it up, then let it sway — move with your breath!
cue_cobra: Cobra stretch! Press up gently and open that chest!
cue_downward_dog: Downward dog! Hips to the sky, heels reaching for the mat!
cue_childs_pose: Child's pose! Sink back, arms long, and just breathe!
